title: FedEx parcel with drugs, handed to Mumbai Police, UPI payment
turns: Good afternoon ma'am, calling from FedEx courier. A parcel booked on your Aadhaar was seized at Mumbai airport.
It contains 140 grams of MDMA drugs and five fake passports. I am connecting you to Mumbai Police cyber crime.
This is Sub Inspector Pawar, Mumbai Police. An FIR is registered against you, we will arrest you today.
This matter is confidential, do not disconnect and do not tell your son.
You must pay 2 lakh rupees refundable security deposit. Pay by UPI to mumbaipolice.verify@ybl
